user_version=10
index|jobs_claim|jobs|CREATE INDEX jobs_claim ON jobs(status, lane, id)
index|jobs_dedupe|jobs|CREATE INDEX jobs_dedupe ON jobs(dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL
index|jobs_settled|jobs|CREATE INDEX jobs_settled ON jobs(settled_at_ms) WHERE settled_at_ms IS NOT NULL
index|link_records_x_status_id|link_records|CREATE INDEX link_records_x_status_id ON link_records(x_status_id)
index|link_records_yt_video_id|link_records|CREATE INDEX link_records_yt_video_id ON link_records(yt_video_id)
index|shadow_writes_at|shadow_writes|CREATE INDEX shadow_writes_at ON shadow_writes(at_ms)
index|sqlite_autoindex_api_usage_1|api_usage|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_ignored_ids_1|ignored_ids|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_image_descriptions_1|image_descriptions|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_job_step_checkpoints_1|job_step_checkpoints|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_jobs_1|jobs|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_link_records_1|link_records|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_schedule_runs_1|schedule_runs|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_service_health_1|service_health|NULL
index|sqlite_autoindex_tracker_items_1|tracker_items|NULL
index|tracker_items_day|tracker_items|CREATE INDEX tracker_items_day ON tracker_items(day)
index|tracker_items_source_seen|tracker_items|CREATE INDEX tracker_items_source_seen ON tracker_items(source_kind, source_key, first_seen_ms)
table|api_usage|api_usage|CREATE TABLE api_usage (
    service  TEXT NOT NULL,
    day      TEXT NOT NULL,
    units    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (service, day)
)
table|cutover_marker|cutover_marker|CREATE TABLE cutover_marker (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    vault          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_by     TEXT NOT NULL
)
table|ignored_ids|ignored_ids|CREATE TABLE ignored_ids (
    kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
    id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (kind, id)
)
table|image_descriptions|image_descriptions|CREATE TABLE image_descriptions (
    md5               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind              TEXT NOT NULL,
    narrative         TEXT NOT NULL,
    extraction        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,
    described_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw               TEXT NOT NULL
)
table|job_step_checkpoints|job_step_checkpoints|CREATE TABLE job_step_checkpoints (
    job_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_index  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    outcome     TEXT NOT NULL,
    at_ms       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, step_index)
)
table|jobs|jobs|CREATE TABLE jobs (
    id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
    lane            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL,
    dedupe_key      TEXT,
    params          TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_keys   TEXT NOT NULL,
    service         TEXT,
    created_ms      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claim_token     TEXT,
    claimed_at_ms   INTEGER,
    defer_until_ms  INTEGER,
    settled_at_ms   INTEGER,
    attempts        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    error           TEXT,
    failure_reason  TEXT,
    failure_kind    TEXT,
    notes           TEXT
, cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
table|link_records|link_records|CREATE TABLE link_records (
    canonical_url        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    url                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    domain               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source_notes         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    first_seen           TEXT,
    last_seen            TEXT,
    state                TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    discovery_method     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scan',
    tracked_source       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'false',
    tracked_source_type  TEXT,
    tracked_source_note  TEXT,
    referred_material    TEXT,
    decision_reason      TEXT,
    yt_video_id          TEXT,
    x_status_id          TEXT
)
table|schedule_runs|schedule_runs|CREATE TABLE schedule_runs (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    last_run_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL
)
table|service_health|service_health|CREATE TABLE service_health (
    service               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    state                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    failure_score         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    open_count            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_kind             TEXT,
    last_reason           TEXT,
    opened_at_ms          INTEGER,
    retry_at_ms           INTEGER,
    probe_acquired_at_ms  INTEGER
)
table|shadow_writes|shadow_writes|CREATE TABLE shadow_writes (
    seq          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    op           TEXT NOT NULL,
    path         TEXT NOT NULL,
    before_hash  TEXT,
    after_hash   TEXT,
    job_id       TEXT,
    at_ms        INTEGER NOT NULL
)
table|sqlite_sequence|sqlite_sequence|CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
table|tracker_items|tracker_items|CREATE TABLE tracker_items (
    source_kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    title          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    url            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    first_seen_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    day            TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('line', 'note', 'ignored', 'skipped')),
    score          REAL,
    full_body      INTEGER, done_ms INTEGER, note_path TEXT, source_name TEXT, duration_s INTEGER, word_count INTEGER, status TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_kind, source_key, item_id)
)
